Episode 225. Unwanted Reunion (3)
Jin's eyes narrowed. A droplet of blood was trickling down his cheek.
Even in the past, it would have been impossible for the old Ann to leave such a scratch on the current Jin. This was the same even during the time when she had accepted the power of Chaos.
"Huh?"
He was so taken aback that he was momentarily speechless. Ann was standing, smiling, emitting an aura of madness that was different from her past self.
It was the madness of someone calmly being evil.
[Uh, what. What's that?]
Murakan, who was busy dealing with Siker, also looked surprised and glanced towards Jin and Ann.
'What, what's with this human...? What the hell is going on?'
Siker, who had merely thought of Ann as a hostage, was also shocked, his eyes wide open. The strange energy coming from Ann was definitely overwhelming, even to him as a demon.
"You seem surprised, our youngest."
Soon, Jin calmly understood the situation.
'Tilias and Misol, who informed me about the brothers, wouldn't have done such a shallow trick. It seems there was something else that Biseps didn't know.'
Biseps, who had learned through a spy that Ragal had captured the brothers, could certainly have overlooked something.
"This is certainly the most unexpected thing recently, Ann. I always thought you were stupid, but I never imagined you could pull off such a fantastic act."

"Ah, yes. I was really stupid in the past... That's why I couldn't destroy you when you were young. It's something I regret. If I were as clever as you, this wouldn't have happened. You wouldn't have succeeded like this, and I wouldn't have lived like a beggar and go to hell."
"Well, I thought you were somewhat repentant, but it seems you're still out of your mind."
"Haha, I'm clearer now than ever."
A white energy was gathering in Ann's left hand, forming a new sword. Back when she was a Rune Kandel Knight, Ann used to use twin swords.
'I didn't feel any premonition when I approached Ann... Is it because she forms her weapons in such a way.'
One can somehow hide their killing intent, but it's impossible to hide the premonition of a hidden sword against a warrior like Jin. That was why Jin didn't notice Ann's true colors at all.
'Besides, that energy is undoubtedly magical, although it's heterogeneous.'
Jin was one of the people in the world who was most knowledgeable about magic, but he had never heard of magic that 'creates things' like swords.
Of course, it is entirely possible to form the shape of a sword with energy like aura or magic power, but the magic Ann conjured was perfectly replicating the texture of ancient perennial iron.
Judging from the form of magic, it wasn't summoning. Literally, Ann just made a weapon with magic.
Perhaps it could be called a 'creation' magic, it was undoubtedly an ability she received from Rokia.
"I'll have to watch that. And you came back from hell just to become a mere nuisance to me? Still no confidence to beat me, pathetic."
"Ah, now I can face reality a bit. I've gotten stronger, but how can I alone kill you? Even if she is stronger, Ann Runkandel is still Ann Runkandel."
"Stop using the name Runkandel from now on. As the head of the family, I recommend you take this warning seriously."

"Haha, are you trying to scratch my heart by becoming the head of the family now? If so, it's a success. I feel so sick I'm going crazy. I've never even dreamed of that position. Anyway, I'm scared, so I can't use the name Runkandel anymore. It's okay, I just got a new name."
"A new name?"
"It's the name of the person who made me like this. To be precise, thanks to the awakening... I realized my real name."
Suddenly, Jin remembered a conversation he had with Dante in the past. It was a conversation about Kwaoul after finishing the curse ceremony and hearing Padler's will.
-His genius is extraordinary. I'm just a little worried though.
-Because he is from the bloodline of Ganesto, just like the curse?

-Yes, if the wills of Sir Padler are true, then Dr. Kwaoul could also become a puppet of Ganesto someday. And perhaps... It may also apply to us, the children of the curse. We also would have received some of Ganesto's blood.

-It's a terrible story. But somehow I think it doesn't matter to you and the remaining knights. If Rokia Ganesto could intervene in your inner selves, the curse ceremony would not have ended as it did.
"Rokia Ganesto, huh."
Jin spoke as if he was sure, to provoke Ann. Ann smiled as if she had no intention of hiding.

"You're really smart. Yes, Ann Ganesto. That's my new name. And I am a being who kills deviant Runkandels... I was destined to be like this from the start. This was my destiny, even before I was born."
Sheeeee....
Jin slowly drew his sword.
"Thanks to you, things have become clearer in many ways."
There were suspicions that Rokia had betrayed the family during the knight period, and until just a moment ago, Ann had unnerved Jin with her unexpectedly gruesome appearance.
But now Rokia's betrayal was confirmed and Ann had become a greater villain through that power.
'Perhaps the other brothers in hell have also become like Ann, I have more enemies now.'
Ann also adjusted her posture and drew up her energy. With her wild yet powerful energy, the debris around her warped and rose into the air.
The two simultaneously charged at each other, brandishing their swords. The ground where the two landed sank from their first collision, sending out a shock wave that distorted the space around them.
"Damn, it's heavy. Even heavier than Luna sister's sword in my memory. As expected, I can't win."
In the continued onslaught from Jin, Ann quickly fell into a defensive stance.
Although it was true that Ann had suddenly gained superhuman combat power, it wasn't comparable to Jin's. She was merely able to hold a roughly equal exchange of blows with Jin.
Jin leisurely engaged Ann as if testing her. Within around ten seconds, shallow cuts began to appear on Ann's body, and Jin gradually increased his speed.
Ann was bleeding red blood just like before she fell into chaos.

'It seems like no other reinforcements will come, and she doesn't have her regenerative abilities from when she fell into chaos. Yet, her attitude, showing no consideration for death, must be because she can either resurrect after dying... or she has a surefire escape plan.'
Ann cannot be killed here.
Jin was convinced of that. After all, Ann would already know about 'Eternalization,' Jin's most special power. She would have also been informed about Jin's ultimate move, the 'Dark Advent' by Loki.

Loki had already extracted Ann from her torture in hell and awakened her with some ability. Regardless of its form, he must have prepared for Ann's death or disappearance. It's obvious that he needed Jin's brothers, whom he turned like this, to accomplish his own goal.
'Even if it's not today, we just need to find a way and deal with them. Ann, other brothers who have changed like this, and Loki Ganesto...'
"Argh!"
The scream of a dying Seker was heard. Murakan directed the power he was pouring into Seker straight at Ann.
He was furious at Loki's betrayal.
[Ann!]
A fiercely dropping black shackle hit Ann's waist. Ann had no energy to properly dodge or block the shackle as she was busy dealing with Jin.
"Ugh!"
As soon as Jin's stance faltered, he dug deeper into Ann's waist. Ann, trying to keep her spilling organs in with her hand, screamed in agony.
From the start, it was burdensome for her to deal with Jin's sword which wasn't at full power, so when Murakan joined, it was virtually the end.
[Tell me, what has Loki been up to all this time? From the moment you first met Temar, from the moment you first set foot in the family, did you have a different purpose?]
"Ah, sorry, Black Dragon Murakan. It's a bit hard for me to answer that while my guts are spilling out."
Even while her body was falling apart, Ann showed no signs of fear. Seeing this, even Murakan realized that Ann wouldn't die today, and he felt cold to the bone.
[Betraying your comrades, showing your true colors after a millennium, and the first person you sent was you. Whatever sinister plan Loki has, it seems like a desperate situation. Tsk.]
Murakan landed on the ground and said.
Anne managed to barely support her trembling legs and alternately stared at Jin and Murakan. She kept bending over, vomiting blood.

“Whew, huck……! Your words are too harsh for someone who died a thousand years ago without knowing anything. Well…… how would you guys understand Ganesto's ideal? You guys are just obsessed with survival and prosperity!”
For a moment, Anne's voice changed. It seemed overlaid with the voice of Rokia, which she had heard in Ketam's painting.
Anne gasped for breath, and after a while, she looked at Jin with a calm face again.

“When I reveal myself to you again, I think I should choose someone of the same level as me to deal with…… so I won't lose my physical form in vain like now. You, after all, are Orabuni's share. Orabuni has inherited much thicker blood and will than me. You can expect it, youngest.”
Jin chuckled.

“Have you already forgotten what you said yourself? Even if you're stronger, Anne is Anne, and Joshua is Joshua. Put away the trivial words, and tell Rokia Ganesto. I know your weakness, so if you keep resisting, you will be more miserable than now.”
“Huhu, you tell too shallow lies. It doesn't suit you.”

“You must know that some of the expedition members returned from the Black Sea not long ago. My father had a message for me through them. About Ganesto. If you report to Rokia, you'll understand what I mean.”
At that remark, Anne's eyes shook for the first time. It was a tremor so tiny that Murakan couldn't recognize it, but Jin didn't miss it.
Maybe it was an eye twitch that occurred as the body collapsed. In fact, there were often such phenomena during conversation.
However, Jin was more inclined to judge that Anne showed a slight hint of embarrassment, rather than that an eye twitch happened again just as he mentioned the Black Sea and Ganesto.
'Anyway, I can't beat her not only in a fight but also in words. There's no way she could actually know the secret of the Black Sea and Ganesto......'
Anne muttered to herself and shook her head slowly.

“It's time to say goodbye. Let's not meet again, youngest. I'll try my best to avoid you. And, say hello to the brothers. If you think of defecting, you're always welcome. After all, we were all born from the same boat.”
Hiss...

As she finished speaking, Anne's physical form quickly scattered into white particles. It was also a foreign magical power, and soon the magical power scattered in all directions and disappeared somewhere.
“I was hoping it wouldn't be, but Rokia this... Sigh. Hey, kid. But what was that talk about Rokia's weakness?”

“It's obviously a nonsense I just made up. I was just testing Anne to see if there was any reaction. The deepest part of the Black Sea is a more unknown area than the underground world, and my father is exploring it, so it seems plausible that he has gained information about Ganesto. And Anne would think she hid it, but it showed.”
“It showed? I didn't notice it.”

“Of course, I'm a little sharper than you, right? I feel a bit guilty about judging my father without permission. Anyway, judging from Anne's reaction, there is a high possibility that Rokia has some kind of weakness. Probably, related to the Black Sea.”
